note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 4(5), NAM 5; A06b Const 4(5), NAM 5; L05 Const 4(8)(a), NAM 7(1)(a)-(c)): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Namibia, 2024
sources.said: Person has been lawfully and ordinarily resident for at least 10 years. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person is a naturalised citizen and voluntarily acquires another citizenship or acquires it involuntarily and fails to renounce the other citizenship within 1 year.
